notes: v3.0.38 - Pull days that used to refuse now import completely. A scheduling-keyword filter was deleting a patient surname in two separate places, so a row resolved to no name and was thrown away as invalid (Friday days came back one patient short, every time); both are fixed and the day closes. A per-row label such as a supervising clinician could be mistaken for a schedule COLUMN header, which both refused the day and - worse - could file every visit under a clinician who did not render it; headers are now taken only from real column positions. Chart opening never types a patient name into athenaOne numeric Patient ID field, which used to raise a blocking dialog that froze the tab mid-pull. Receipts now name which stage refused a row (snapshotParse, invalidRows.reason, attributionCoverage.verdict, headerProvenance) so a failure explains itself instead of being silent. Requires Chrome 116+.
